title: 第74章 抢占节点，签署前夕

第74章 抢占节点，签署前夕-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

“中投信达那边牵头的叫方志远，副总裁。华清资本是个姓孙的合伙人，孙乾。”

林川报出两个名字。

齐衡在脑子里过了一遍。方志远没印象，但“华清”两个字一出来——

“华清……孙乾？”

“对。”

齐衡没废话，直接掏手机翻通讯录，拨了出去。

“老周，我。帮我查两件事。第一，中投信达最近有没有派人往长三角跑，盯的哪个园区。第二，华清资本的孙乾，最近活动什么项目。”

电话那头顿了一拍。“衡哥，急吗？”

“半小时之内要结果。”

挂了。

手机塞回裤兜，齐衡拍了拍膝盖。

“我有人在部委体系里做参事，这种事他最门清。”

林川点了下头，没多问。

车子下了高架，转进张江主干道。

三号研发楼。

叶知秋提前安排好了动线。

齐衡团队四个人跟着叶知秋走前面逐项对接。林川带齐衡和齐韵在后面，步子慢了半拍。

芯海微电子二期实验室，三千五百平无尘车间，晶圆测试线已经跑起来了。

方锐配套的物流中转仓，两家新入驻的通信设备公司——一路走完，三个人站在连廊下面。

齐衡仰头看了一眼楼顶。

“林总，半导体原材料本地化这个方向，市场需求摆在那里，早做晚做区别不大吧？”

林川指了指面前的三号楼，又指了指左边的芯海。

“芯海做基带芯片，上游需要高纯度硅、特种气体、光刻胶。现在全进口，从日韩到上海港再转到园区，最快二十一天。”

“你的原材料本地化之后，成都出发，四十八小时到仓库。”

“省的不是运费，是整条产线的响应速度。”

齐衡点头。

“但这只是第一层。”

“第二层？”

“芯海的芯片卖给谁？右边那两家通信设备公司。他们做完模组卖给谁？珠三角的手机代工厂。”

林川转过身。

“从石英砂进仓库到手机出厂，中间每个环节在三公里半径之内完成。这才叫链条。”

齐衡的脚步停了。

做投资这么多年，PPT上画的产业链示意图看了无数。但站在这里，箭头和方框全变成了实实在在的楼、实实在在的货。

“所以你抢位置不是抢一栋楼。”

“是抢节点。”林川接上，

“制造、供应、出口，三个口全卡死，后面谁想做同样的事，只能在外圈转。核心区块就这么大，签了排他协议，拿再多钱也只能看着。”

齐衡回头扫了一眼身后那几栋楼，摇了摇头，没接话。

齐韵一直走在两人右后方。

她没插嘴，忽然开口。

“林总，你说出口端也要卡。张江是研发园区，出口物流怎么走？”

林川指着园区西南角一条正在修的路。

"The leader of China Investment Cinda is Fang Zhiyuan, the vice president. Huaqing Capital is a partner named Sun, Sun Qian."

Lin Chuan reported two names.

Qi Heng went through it in his mind.Fang Zhiyuan had no impression, but as soon as the word "Huaqing" came out——

"Hua Qing... Sun Qian?"

"Yes."

Qi Heng didn't waste any time. He took out his phone, looked through his address book, and dialed.

"Old Zhou, me. Check two things for me. First, has CIC Cinda sent anyone to the Yangtze River Delta recently, and which park is it targeting? Second, what projects has Sun Qian from Huaqing Capital been involved in recently?"

There was a pause on the other end of the phone."Brother Heng, are you in a hurry?"

"Results are due within half an hour."

Hang up.

Putting the phone back into his trouser pocket, Qi Heng patted his knees.

"I have someone who works as a counselor in the ministry system, and he is the most knowledgeable about this kind of thing."

Lin Chuan nodded and didn't ask any more questions.

The car got off the elevated road and turned onto Zhangjiang main road.

R&D Building No. 3.

Ye Zhiqiu arranged the movement in advance.

The four members of Qi Heng's team followed Ye Zhiqiu to the front and connected them one by one.Lin Chuan led Qi Heng and Qi Yun behind, walking half a beat slower.

Chipsea Microelectronics Phase II Laboratory, a 3,500-square-meter dust-free workshop, and the wafer test line is already in operation.

Fangrui's supporting logistics transfer warehouse, two newly settled communication equipment companies - after walking all the way, three people stood under the corridor.

Qi Heng raised his head and glanced at the roof.

"Mr. Lin, in the direction of localizing semiconductor raw materials, the market demand is there. It doesn't make much difference if we do it early or later, right?"

Lin Chuan pointed to Building 3 in front of him, and then pointed to Xinhai on the left.

"Chipsea makes baseband chips, which require high-purity silicon, special gases, and photoresist upstream. Now they are all imported. From Japan and South Korea to Shanghai Port and then to the park, the fastest is 21 days."

"After your raw materials are localized, we will depart from Chengdu and arrive at the warehouse within 48 hours."

“What we save is not the freight, but the response speed of the entire production line.”

Qi Heng nodded.

“But that’s just the first layer.”

"Second floor?"

"Who do Chip Hai sell their chips to? The two communication equipment companies on the right. Who do they sell their finished modules to? The mobile phone foundries in the Pearl River Delta."

Lin Chuan turned around.

"From the quartz sand entering the warehouse to the mobile phone leaving the factory, every link in between is completed within a radius of three kilometers. This is called a chain."

Qi Heng's footsteps stopped.

After so many years of investing, I have seen countless industrial chain diagrams drawn on PPTs.But standing here, the arrows and boxes have all turned into real buildings and real goods.

"So when you compete for a location, you don't compete for a building."

"It's about grabbing nodes." Lin Chuan took over,

"Manufacturing, supply, and export are all stuck. Anyone who wants to do the same thing in the future can only move around in the outer circle. The core block is so big. If you sign an exclusive agreement, no matter how much money you get, you can only watch."

Qi Heng turned around and glanced at the buildings behind him, shook his head and did not answer.

Qi Yun has been walking behind and to the right of the two of them.

She didn't interrupt, but suddenly spoke.

"Mr. Lin, you said there is also a problem at the export end. Zhangjiang is a R&D park, how do you go about export logistics?"

Lin Chuan pointed to a road under construction in the southwest corner of the park.
